name.description: Name of the regular expression. Required for create operations.

expression_type.description: Type of Regular expression. Required. Possible values: 0 - Character string included; 1 - Any character string included; 2 - Character string not included; 3 - Result is TRUE; 4 - Result is FALSE.

exp_delimiter.description: Expression delimiter. Supported if expression_type is set to "Any character string included". Default: ",".

case_sensitive.description: Case sensitivity. Possible values: 0 - Case insensitive; 1 - Case sensitive. Default: 0.
